title: Alex Edelman: Jenom pro nás
plot: Broadwayské představení stand-up komikaAlexe Edelmanao tom, jak se jako Žid rozhodl navštívit v New Yorku setkání bílých nacionalistů, protkávají další příběhy z jeho neurodivergentního života včetně vzpomínky z dětství, kdy se jeho židovská rodina rozhodla oslavit Vánoce…(TroiMae)

reviews.author: Devadesát Dva
reviews.text:
"OH, CAN U BELIEVE IT?" (life-saving line) Anti-semicircle. FROZEN CHOSEN. "Someone offered me a cocaine couple years ago and I tried it. And they were like: How'd ya feel? And I was like: Like there's homework to do!" (...) And I reached for a slice of pizza that had some sausage on it or pepperoni, something not kosher. And my grandfather was there, and he saw me reaching, and he kicked my hand. Kicked. And he said, “You can’t have that, David. We’re Jewish.” And I said, “What does that mean?” And with a totally straight face, he just went, “It means you’ll never be happy.” And I said, “Be’emet?” which means, “For real?” And he went, “Oh, yeah.” And I said, “Why?” And he said, “It means you’ll never be happy with the way things are. And you’ll always question things. And even when things are pretty good, they won’t seem that good to you.” And I said, “Papa, I don’t wanna be Jewish!” And then my grandfather laughed at me. And he just went… “Sweetie, that’s the most Jewish thing there is. (...) My mum put up stocking above fireplace with our names on them in hebrew. (...) 'He's not even a real Jew." "Dad?" (...)  
And AJ’s like, “Hmm. But we do know Santa Claus.” And the other kids are like, “Who’s Santa Claus?” And AJ’s like, “Oh! He’s amazing. He’s a fat man, but it’s a good kind of fat. And he comes down non-Jewish chimneys in middle of the night, and he gives gifts to young Christians. But… But, last night, because he’s friends with our dad… …he came to our house and he left this Walkman underneath the tree that my parents put in the garage, and he ate all of the cookies.” And the principal said, “Professor Edelman, is this true?” And, apparently, my father just went, “No. It… It’s not entirely true.” And Rabbi Falk said, “What do you mean it’s not entirely true?” Then my father said, “Cheryl and I ate the cookies.”(14.05.2025)
